profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.tagline: Software Engineer specializing in scalable backend systems, data architectures, and automation-driven solutions.

about.heading: ABOUT ME
paragraphs: I’m a software engineer focused on data platforms, automation, and robust backend APIs. I’m passionate about distributed systems, infrastructure, and solving complex problems to create efficient, resilient solutions.
My interest in computing and mathematics dates back to eighth grade, when I began exploring how mathematical concepts could be transformed into software solutions to solve practical problems.

I graduated from St. Joseph’s University in 2021 with a B.S. in Computer Science & Mathematics. Along the way, I joined the DS3 Program at Microsoft Research NYC and interned at Tarifica, where I built data systems and dashboards to support analysis and decision-making, an experience that sparked my passion for data-driven solutions.

Since graduating, I’ve worked at Middesk and Ribbon Health, designing production data pipelines, building entity resolution and master data management (MDM) platforms, optimizing backend APIs for enterprise-scale operations, and developing systems that prioritize performance, reliability, and data quality. These experiences have strengthened my expertise in backend engineering, cloud platforms and modern data architecture.

As software continues to evolve with AI, I enjoy exploring new technologies, building automation and developer tooling, and creating the data infrastructure that powers reliable, scalable and intelligent applications.
Outside of work, I enjoy movies, travel, and music.

contact.heading: CONTACT
contact.description: I would love to connect with like-minded professionals. Please feel free to reach out. I’m always open to discussing new ideas, collaborations and opportunities.
